"Bindiya Chamkegi" is a memorable song from the 1969 Bollywood movie Do Raaste, featuring the iconic pairing of Mumtaz and Rajesh Khanna. The film, directed by Raj Khosla, was a major success and remains one of the classic movies of that era.
